title: GitStore Product
description: YAML frontmatter for a GitStore Product resource. A Product resource is a Markdown file: this schema validates only the frontmatter object between the opening and closing '---' delimiters. The remaining Markdown content is the free-form product description body and is not covered by this schema. See docs/products/product-spec.md for the full authoring contract.

ObjectMeta.description: Author-writable resource metadata. Do not set uid, resourceVersion, generation, creationTimestamp, revision, ownerReferences, or finalizers — those fields are system-managed and any of them present in an authored file causes the push to be rejected.

name.description: DNS label format: lowercase alphanumeric and hyphens, 1-63 characters, no leading/trailing hyphen. Identifies this Product uniquely within its namespace.

namespace.description: Optional. When omitted, the namespace is inferred from the owning repository at push time. When present, it is validated to match the inferred namespace — it does not select a different namespace.

labels.description: Optional key/value labels. Keys may use an optional "prefix/name" form; prefix ≤ 253 chars, name segment ≤ 63 chars. Values ≤ 63 chars.

annotations.description: Optional key/value annotations. No length restriction.

ObjectReference.description: A pointer to another catalogue resource.

name.description: Required. Name of the referenced resource.

FileReference.description: Identifies a File resource by name and kind.

name.description: Required — the name of the referenced File resource, even when optional is true.

optional.description: When true, admission succeeds even if the referenced File is absent.

MediaDefinition.description: A product media slot referencing a File resource.

ProductOptionDefinition.description: A variant dimension (e.g. Colour, Size). "name" must be unique within the enclosing spec.options list.

name.description: Required. Must be unique within spec.options.

ProductSpec.description: Author-controlled declarative specification for a product. All fields are individually optional; spec may be an empty object.

categoryRef.description: Reference to the parent CategoryTaxonomy. If present, categoryRef.name is required.

tags.description: Free-form tag list. No per-tag length constraint.

options.description: Variant dimensions (e.g. colour, size). Each entry's name must be unique within this list.
